messages:
lucy: short RFC follow-up on capability discovery for Hosted/Dedicated/Private. want a decision today.

devin: two options: static manifest (good for air-gapped Private) or probe endpoint (dynamic for Hosted/Dedicated). prefer single canonical pattern with fallbacks.

maria: support both but define precedence: local manifest > probe > conservative default. manifest required for installer-based Private.

ashok: agree. capability schema should be small: name + min_version + optional params to avoid boolean sprawl.

devin: example: capabilities: - name: streaming_v2 min_version: "2.0" - name: kv_cache min_version: "1.1" params: "max_prefix=256"

lucy: ops/security: probe must require ephemeral signed token, rate-limit, minimal logs. manifest avoids outbound requirement.

maria: surface KMS/HSM availability as capability (kms_external) so clients can choose local fallback.

devin: rollout plan: (1) spec v1 + schema, (2) SDK init reads manifest then probe, (3) runtime gates features and emits telemetry, (4) canary Hosted 5% + one Dedicated cluster.

lucy: compatibility: older runtimes default to conservative feature set. add header X-Rw-Capabilities: opt-in=v1 for opt-ins.

ashok: tests: fake-adapter for e2e toggles, offline manifest test.

maria: ops will update deploy manifests, create tokens, and own docs/examples. opening PR shortly.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: queued canary job architecture-runtime/capability-probe id 2026-09-14-88.

devin: clients should cache capabilities (TTL 5m) and log warnings on mid-run changes.

lucy: decision: proceed with dual-support + clear precedence, schema-based capabilities, auth for probe, and rollout plan. closing.
